integrity: Analytic proof with exact stream decomposition and coupon-collector limits. Standalone finite-state checker supports the decomposition but does not certify infinite results; historical priority and independent validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Fixed reset probability strictly between zero and one; root in first part; complete bipartite graphs with independent uniform nonreset moves; fixed critical-window perturbation. Other graph families, vanishing reset rates and absolute priority are not established.
title: A two-class Gumbel crossover for cover times with root resetting on complete bipartite graphs
